summary: Puskwaskau lookout in Alberta: an earlier tower in service by the mid-1940s, and a 30 m steel tower dated 2015 that the provincial record lists as active.

facts.design: Steel lookout tower, 30 m (98 ft) tall, per the provincial record

access.note: The provincial record gives the access mode as drive and marks the tower active. A regional archive says the public may no longer climb Alberta lookout towers. No source read says the site is open to visitors.

events.note: Archive, quoting a Department of Lands and Mines annual report: the Puskwaskau tower was completed and began operation in the mid-1940s. The archive gives no single year.
Provincial record: year constructed 2015 for the steel tower listed at Puskwaskau. The record does not say whether it replaced the mid-1940s tower.

sources.title: Wildfire Lookouts of Alberta, layer records for Puskwaskau, Ponton and Rainbow

notes_for_editor: The 2015 date is the steel tower in the provincial record. The mid-1940s date rests on one regional archive blog quoting a Department of Lands and Mines annual report; the report itself was not read. The archive gives no single year, so the 1940s build event has no year. No source says whether the 2015 tower replaced the mid-1940s one, so the two build events are kept separate. The brief's agency name (Alberta Wildfire) is not quoted from a source read; the layer metadata names the Wildfire Management Branch, Forestry Division. The brief's access value 'closed' is not supported; see the correction. The layer metadata classifies the dataset as Protected, so only single attribute values are quoted. Two searches found no other history for this tower.
